title: scene: implement the cordite requests (jmap-chat-spec 93f2258)
description: Implement in jmap-scene-types/-server/-client what jmap-chat-spec 93f2258 added to scene-00 and scene-wss-00 (decision 60): SceneRegion/broadcast + SceneRegionEvent (supportsRegionBroadcast); observer subscriptions (SceneStreamEnable.observe, supportsObserve, SceneRegion.allowObservers default true, observerCount, forbidden with regionIds); Avatar Visibility (hide avatars / withhold properties per caller, /changes created/destroyed on view change, suppress SceneAvatarEvent); worldStateEquals on SceneRegion/query; SceneAvatar.regionState (supportsAvatarRegionState, owner/admin/server writes). Implementation list: docs/upstream/2026-11-20/spec-patches/README-scene.md. Start after the scene-server /set split (eedw) lands.
